/-!
# Ben Green's Open Problem 81

Let $A$ be a set of size $n$ integers. Is there some absolute constant $c > 0$ and $\theta$
such that $\sum_{a \in A} \cos(a \theta) \leq - c \sqrt{n}$?

*References:*
- [Ben Green's Open Problem 81](https://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/greenbj/papers/open-problems.pdf#section.11)
- [erdosproblems.com/510](https://www.erdosproblems.com/510)

This file points to the canonical formalization in `FormalConjectures.ErdosProblems.«510»`.
-/

reformulations.difference: The imported canonical theorem uses a strict inequality for sufficiently large cardinalities. The standard positive-integer problem can instead be stated with a non-strict inequality for every nonempty finite set.
reformulations.equivalence_argument: Strictness is interchangeable by shrinking the positive constant; this eventual strict/non-strict equivalence was proved in the scratch file. Small cardinalities can also be absorbed uniformly: for f(θ)=Σ_{a∈A}cos(aθ), write M=-min f. For any a∈A, normalized integration gives ∫(f+M)cos(aθ)=1/2, while f+M≥0 and cos(aθ)≤1 imply M≥1/2. Thus, given an eventual bound starting at N₀≥1, choosing a smaller constant no greater than min(c/2,1/(4√N₀)) covers every smaller positive cardinality. The positive-frequency convention is explicit in Bedert's primary paper.

sources_consulted: Ben Green, '100 Open Problems', §11, Problem 81, its comments and 2025 update: https://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/greenbj/papers/open-problems.pdf (text read through https://r.jina.ai/https://people.maths.ox.ac.uk/greenbj/papers/open-problems.pdf).

Erdős Problem 510, statement, remarks, and OPEN status: https://www.erdosproblems.com/510 (read through https://r.jina.ai/https://www.erdosproblems.com/510, including rendered HTML to recover the formulas).
Benjamin Bedert, 'Polynomial bounds for the Chowla Cosine Problem', arXiv:2509.05260v3, introduction and preliminary observations; LaTeX source downloaded from https://arxiv.org/e-print/2509.05260.
https://eudml.org/doc/278427 — bibliographic record for Ruzsa's 'Negative values of cosine sums'; the linked full text was unavailable.

review.notes: The reviewed file contains only imports and a module docstring: it introduces no mathematical declarations, answer slots, or status attributes. Its synopsis reproduces Green's wording, and Erdős's page explicitly identifies Problem 510 with Green's Problem 81. The canonical import was inspected as supporting context. Its positive-integer domain matches Bedert's explicit formulation; the sources' summaries loosely say 'integers'. Lean checks passed for the strict/non-strict reformulation, the natural-number cutoff interpretation, admissible sets of every cardinality, and zero/empty/singleton boundary cases. The square-root problem remains open in the consulted sources. Bedert's improved bound does not invalidate the imported solved 1/7-power result. No repository files were edited.
